_help: The guide's script: one opener and one joke a day. Edit freely; the app picks it up next time it opens online. Blanks: {me} {title} {km} {endTime}. Days 1 to 6 (Sun Jan 17 = 1). 'practice' is the NYC page.
name: Shai

1.open: Morning {me}. Day one. Fresh legs, zero excuses.
1.joke: Folie Douce is the finish line, not the warm-up.

2.open: Morning {me}. Day two. Legs still attached?
2.joke: Nobody ever regretted the second hot chocolate.

3.joke: Your thighs filed a complaint. Complaint ignored.

4.open: Morning {me}. Day four. Basically a local now.
4.joke: Locals don’t stop for photos. You will.

5.open: Morning {me}. Day five. Pace yourself. Or don’t.
5.joke: Slowest one today buys the vin chaud.

6.open: Morning {me}. Last day. Make it count.
6.joke: Fewest reds today buys the last round.

practice.joke: The M15 counts as a gondola. Don’t tell anyone.
